name: Barco ClickShare

options.label: ID of wallpaper
options.description: default wallpapers have ID 1 and 2, user wallpapers start at 1001

feedbacks.name: In Use
feedbacks.description: True if the app or a button is connected to the Clickshare

feedbacks.name: Sharing
feedbacks.description: True if someone is streaming a desktop to the Clickshare

feedbacks.name: Idle
feedbacks.description: True if no one is connected to the Clickshare

feedbacks.name: Available
feedbacks.description: True if some one is connected to the Clickshare but no one is streaming

notes: Complete list: 1 action (src/actions.ts) and 4 boolean feedbacks (src/feedbacks.ts), all registered in single setActionDefinitions/setFeedbackDefinitions calls.
The module talks to the ClickShare REST API (config: IP, API port default 4003, username, password; src/config.ts, src/barco-api/barco.ts). Credentials are config fields, not catalogued.

selectWallpaper parses the (variable-resolved) text with parseInt and sends it as the wallpaper id (src/actions.ts:19-23). The regex is the value of Regex.NUMBER from @companion-module/base (/^\d+$/), written out here as in the other catalog files; it was not read from the installed dependency.

The four feedbacks have no options. inUse = isInUse, sharing = isSharing, idle = !isInUse, available = isInUse && !isSharing, taken from the module's polled state (src/feedbacks.ts). Each subscribe/unsubscribe adjusts a subscription counter that controls polling (self.subscriptions).
Default style of all feedbacks: black text on red (combineRgb(0,0,0) / combineRgb(255,0,0)).
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.6.0: options do not support expressions.
